statement: A replica reassigned while its node is down, or a crash mid-cleanup, no longer leaves a stale nodes-p* replica .db with no startup reconciliation: a startup sweep reconciles on-disk replica files against the authoritative assignment (the typed evidence / membership manifest from startup-evidence-single-identity-decision-v2) so orphaned replica state is removed or quarantined before it can be read as durable evidence. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/stale-replica-file-startup-reconciliation-v2.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — startup-replica-reconciliation-sweep receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The reconciliation keys on the membership manifest / typed evidence from startup-evidence-single-identity-decision; it should land after that Quest so the sweep compares against the canonical assignment, not the raw file union it replaces.
An orphaned replica file must be removed or quarantined before it can be read as durable evidence; the sweep must not itself become a new reader of ambiguous state.
Each new regression test must fail when the reconciliation sweep is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
